description: This Java source file defines the SharingMenuHelper class, which provides utility methods for managing sharing permissions and visibility logic within the Android client of Nextcloud Notes. It includes methods to determine permission types, get permission names, and check reshare capabilities based on OCShare object properties.

classes.name: SharingMenuHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to determine sharing permissions and UI visibility logic for sharing menu options.

methods.name: isUploadAndEditingAllowed
methods.description: Checks if upload and editing permissions are granted for a given OCShare object.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Determines if the share is read-only based on permissions.

methods.name: isFileDrop
methods.description: Checks if the share is configured as a file drop.

methods.name: isSecureFileDrop
methods.description: Checks if the share is a secure file drop, combining create and read permissions.

methods.name: getPermissionName
methods.description: Returns a localized string describing the permission level of the share.

methods.name: getPermissionCheckedItem
methods.description: Returns the index of the current permission setting within a provided array, based on the share's permissions.

methods.name: getPermissionIndexFromArray
methods.description: Helper method to find the index of a permission string within an array.

methods.name: canReshare
methods.description: Checks if the share allows resharing based on permissions.
